question: Does verified intermediate-state supervision produce useful computation beyond direct training and trained constant-token compute, and what survives on the direct path?
source: Synthetic16-node two-permutation program execution. This laboratory is not natural-language pretraining or evidence of a novel previously unknown algorithm.

data.composition: New maps/depth4-6 and rsrs/srsr motifs absent from TRAIN
data.longer: New maps/depth7-10; held motifs excluded to isolate length
data.counterfactual: Swap two entries of one permutation, exactly one used on original path; earlier execution states fixed and final state changes. Variants share a bootstrap family.
data.restrictions: Observed paths are simple, not arbitrary cyclic programs. All complete maps are distinct; elementary edges repeat.

candidate_arms.direct: Answer-only SFT plus the same empty Work format.
candidate_arms.trace: Ordinary single-model full verified CoT and final answer; no separate writer/reader.
candidate_arms.pause: Constant existing FIM-pad inputs,6 per available program step, never predicted; trained via answer gradients.

candidate_training.initialization: Actual fresh Qwen3-1.7B-Base for each arm/seed, unchanged embedding table; no new token resize.
candidate_training.views: 50% direct and50% arm-specific, interleaved within every epoch; four passes give each question two of each.
candidate_training.loss: Separately mean-normalized final field/EOS and optional trace. Same final-answer weight in all arms; supplied pauses have no prediction loss.
candidate_training.no_claim: All arms still use causal CE. Extra intermediate labels are privileged but exactly computable from available prefix; not autonomous discovery.
not_yet_frozen: Actual memory/throughput/recovery qualification and resource budget
Retention/space plan for newly created transient optimizer states

planned_endpoints.primary: Free complete answers on held composition: trace inference versus direct inference and trained-pause inference; two seeds separately, paired family bootstrap.
secondary: Same-weight direct answers for every arm, compared with matched direct model.
Interpolation and unseen-depth accuracy separately; no pooled convenient aggregate.
Every intermediate transition correct, expected step count, natural stopping and cap/error/unsupported counts.
Both counterfactual variants correct; do not count two variants as independent observations.
Root-excluded correct/corrupt/donor partial-prefill diagnostics; no supplied final answer as a capability oracle.
Actual generated actions, supplied positions, training targets and measured latency. Equal positions do not imply equal execution graphs or FLOPs.

current_evidence.data_and_token_audit: PASS across38912 questions/19456 families, maximum full token length155.
current_evidence.CPU_checks: 1838 tests pass; CPU smoke/compile pass; all131072 native TRAIN packs pass.
current_evidence.packing_audit: Independent all32768 rows times four views: identical final-answer labels, disjoint separately normalized trace labels, supplied pauses receive no token-prediction loss.

next: Publish/protect CPU evidence, then prepare only an eight-update all-view qualification with a fresh-process full-state restore. No learning study is released.
causal_scope: Trace treatment changes both auxiliary targets and some answer-training contexts. A positive comparison supports a complete supervised recipe, not a pure auxiliary-gradient effect, proven internalization or autonomous discovery.
